title: UPDATE: Humansand Lowers Agent API Costs and Adds New 'Ultra' Tier for Complex Coding
summary:
The developer of the Ampersand assistant updated its Agent API this week to include a new high-capacity tier and lower fees for existing service levels. The company is reducing costs for all of its "effort levels," which are bundled agent configurations optimized for specific research tasks, and has introduced an "ultra" level to handle the most demanding and long-running requests.

The pricing adjustments are part of an effort to optimize the API's technology stack to maximize the amount of intelligence provided per dollar. The updates follow the release of Ampersand's multi-agent coding mode, which recently recorded a 92.2% score on the SWE-bench Pro v2 HARD-51 benchmark, matching the performance of Fable 5.1 and Gemini 4 Argon.

selectedTweets.text:
Co-Coding:  frontier coding by working together

We trained Ampersand to work better with people - and found that multi-agent Ampersand matches frontier coding models while being faster and cheaper, despite no extra coding training
- 92.2% on SWE-bench Pro v2 HARD-51, matching Fable 5.1 (while 70% cheaper) and Gemini 4 Argon and outperforming Astra, Muse Wonder, and Kimi K3
- 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, on par with Gemini 4 Argon and ahead of Astra, Grok-4.7, Kimi K3, and Deepseek-v4-pro

Try co(llaborative)-coding with Ampersand’s multi-agent mode, available exclusively through our Agent API

Have fun building together - for the next week, get a $250 API credit to try it out!
